race.comment: ALL EYES ON ERIN (7) resumed from a spell last start with a sound second over 1000m at Ballarat when she did her best work late. This is an easier assignment and can get the job done. SAINT WILLO (6) hasn't raced since finishing 3 lengths back in fourth over 1100m at Bendigo four-and-a-half months ago. Fitter for two trials, placing most recently. Among the leading chances. KIRKSTONE (8) is a daughter of Ole Kirk who has placed at her only two jumpouts this time in and looks ready to go on debut, especially from the low draw. RWANDA (9) is another first-starter from a powerful stable who has drawn favourably and the $950k filly has placed in all three of her trials ahead of the debut.
